description:
Adds levels and levels' members to the issue security scheme. You can add up to 100 levels per request.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the issue security scheme.
parameters.name: schemeId

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["some-wrong-string is not a valid value. The issue security scheme ID must be a positive integer."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["You are not authorized to perform this action. Administrator privileges are required."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user doesn't have the necessary permission.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Issue security scheme with ID 10000 not found."],"errors":{}}

404.description: Returned if the security scheme isn't found.
